in_hebrew.name: חרסטיין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word 'חרש' (charash), meaning 'to trample', and the suffix '-תין' (-tayn), which can mean 'mountain' or 'strength'. Hence, 'Herstein' can be interpreted as 'Mountain of Strength'.

in_greek.name: Ἡρστεῖνος
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'Ἡρστός' (herstos), which means 'strong one' or 'hero'.

in_latin.name: Hersteinius
in_latin.long_meaning: A name derived from the Latin word 'heros', which means 'hero' or 'strong one'.
